reasons: An end-of-run check does not cover the entire execution.
The applicability condition near is undefined.
Object-root height is not necessarily table or support height.
Robot-contact causation is not established by the available observations.
The assumption that the basket remains on the table is unnecessary for this requirement.
suggested_revision_direction: State a qualitative no-unintended-fall requirement for non-target objects over the full manipulation interval. Defer operational fall/support/temporal criteria until validated, avoid near, remove unsupported contact causation and the basket assumption.
